plan.detail: SEARCH checks USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
SEARCH monitors USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_monitors_1 (id=?)
SEARCH latest USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

defect: Grouped max(sequence) visited the complete retained history for every overview card. The measured 16.9-second query exceeded the ordinary ten-second worker command deadline, potentially faulting readiness on an otherwise healthy database.
correction: One SQL query now uses an index-backed maximum sequence probe per selected monitor and a rowid lookup; only COMPLETED rows supply latestLatencyMs, including failed HTTP observations. Newer unsettled/cancelled checks and monitors without observations retain their prior semantics.
limitation: Isolated read-only query comparison on a shared workstation; reference-load API percentiles are separate.
